name: Q-SafeRx-DailyMed-10
source_policy: Real drug indications and interaction evidence are taken from current/near-current DailyMed labels; the benchmark patient-condition combination is a synthetic optimization instance, not a real patient.
objective: Minimize number of selected drugs while covering all required conditions, avoiding high-severity interactions, and penalizing moderate interactions.
note: This is a research benchmark, not a prescribing recommendation.
